name: Khan Dez'hepah
summary: After The Kolkar of Desolace, Felgur Twocuts sets you against the Kolkar's leader, Khan Dez'hepah. Many centaur clans fight one another across Desolace, and Felgur wants the Kolkar disrupted before the clans unite.

sections.title: Divided Clans
sections.body: The Kolkar are only one of the centaur clans of Desolace. Many roam the dry plains, fighting and dying at one another's hands. Felgur Twocuts does not mind, because the centaur are strong and brutal, and a united centaur people would be a fierce foe for the Horde. They must be dealt with before that happens.

sections.title: The Kolkar Leader
sections.body: Felgur's first move is to disrupt the Kolkar by killing their leader, Khan Dez'hepah. The Kolkar Village lies northeast of where Felgur stands, and Felgur wants the khan's head brought back.

faq.q: Why does Felgur Twocuts want Khan Dez'hepah dead?
faq.answer: Felgur worries that the centaur clans may unite against the Horde. Killing Khan Dez'hepah is meant to disrupt the Kolkar clan first.
In the Kolkar Village, northeast of Felgur Twocuts in Desolace.

faq.q: What does Felgur want brought back?
faq.answer: Khan Dez'hepah's head, brought back to Felgur Twocuts.
The Kolkar of Desolace. After it, Felgur Twocuts sends you against the Kolkar leader, Khan Dez'hepah.
